metas.name: Inside Out 2
metas.description: Continues the journey of Riley's emotions with new characters and relatable teenage themes.

metas.name: The Mitchells vs. the Machines
metas.description: A high-energy, hilarious adventure about a family saving the world from a robot apocalypse.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: An epic adventure featuring a deep bond between a boy and a dragon, much like Raya and the Last Dragon.

metas.name: Lilo & Stitch
metas.description: A unique story about 'ohana' and a mischievous alien that fans of Moana will enjoy.

metas.name: Elemental
metas.description: A visually stunning film with clever world-building about elements living together, similar to Zootopia.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description: A charming and universally loved film about a kind-hearted bear that is perfect for family viewing.

metas.name: Finding Dory
metas.description: A delightful sequel focusing on Dory's search for her family, featuring many characters from Finding Nemo.

metas.name: The Emperor's New Groove
metas.description: One of Disney's funniest comedies, featuring a selfish emperor who gets turned into a llama.

metas.name: The Secret World of Arrietty
metas.description: A beautiful Studio Ghibli film about tiny people living under the floorboards, similar to The Borrowers.

metas.name: Madagascar
metas.description: A group of zoo animals find themselves in the wild, leading to hilarious results similar to Rio.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: The legendary original film that sets the stage for Lion King II and Mufasa: The Lion King.
